GsSocket>>acceptTimeoutMs:

Public native milliseconds API. Adapter finite accept forces NONBLOCKING true, waits readiness for seconds*1000, then uses acceptTimeoutMs:0. Disappeared readiness returns nil without indefinite rewait. Nil+active+noError/WouldBlock/TryAgain/TimedOut is timeout; other reported errors normalize. -1 retains indefinite accept. The native API uses per-wait timeouts, not a hard absolute deadline. Live empty bound listener20ms -> nil,nilError,20ms,stillActive; closed listener -> nil,NotSocket. Default new socket NONBLOCKING=true verified, adapter enforces it explicitly.
